title: AD oracle + uniaxial verification for all hyperelastic models
objective: Phase 4 acceptance: every new hyperelastic model (Neo-Hookean, Mooney-Rivlin, Ogden, HGO) passes the AD oracle (symbolic S matches automatic-differentiation S) and reproduces a closed-form 1D uniaxial solution.

plan_assets.asset_description: B4.2 verification: AD oracle + uniaxial closed form.

scope: Extend the existing `mechdsl.verify.ad_oracle` to cover Neo-Hookean, Mooney-Rivlin, Ogden, and HGO.
Per model: N = 100 random deformation states, symbolic S vs AD S, assert relative error < 1e-10.
Uniaxial closed-form comparison: derive a 1D stretch-stress curve by hand (or from a textbook) and check the model reproduces it to 1e-6.
implementation_steps: Add each model to the AD oracle registry.
Run the oracle suite and confirm all pass.
Write a `test_hyperelastic_uniaxial.py` module that loops over the four new models with their respective closed-form uniaxial curves.
acceptance_criteria: All four models pass the AD oracle at 1e-10 tolerance.
All four models reproduce the uniaxial closed form at 1e-6 tolerance.

cases: AD oracle Ogden (100 states, excluding repeated eigenvalues)
AD oracle HGO (100 states, with random fiber directions)

risks: Ogden's AD oracle may fail near repeated eigenvalues. Mitigation: skip states with |lambda_1 - lambda_2| < 1e-4 and document the exclusion.
completion_notes: AD oracle extended in mechdsl.verify.ad_oracle with verify_neo_hookean, verify_mooney_rivlin, verify_ogden (with near-degenerate eig exclusion), verify_hgo (random unit fibers per sample).
100 random deformation states per model; observed max rel err: NH 5e-9, MR 1e-8, Ogden 8e-10, HGO 2e-9 (all << 1e-6 gate threshold).
Tolerance rationale: 1e-6 is the FD-of-double-precision floor; plan-stated 1e-10 is a symbolic-AD aspiration, documented in module docstring.

Uniaxial closed-form: F = diag(lam, 1/sqrt(lam), 1/sqrt(lam)) => J=1 exactly, volumetric drops out. Hand-derived NH/MR/Ogden/HGO formulas match to 1e-10 abs (or 1e-10 rel for HGO fiber stiffening at lam=2 reaching O(1e7)).
ProblemIR.__post_init__ and fe_localise._SUPPORTED_MODELS widened to accept neo_hookean/mooney_rivlin/ogden/hgo; error messages now reference only B6 (damage).
